summary: Package exports an OpenSSL-encrypted opaque blob as its sole API
details: The package's only export is `desKey`, which is the contents of a 49KB file `apps/docs/app/des.db` read synchronously at require time. The file is a base64-wrapped OpenSSL `Salted__` ciphertext (begins `U2FsdGVkX1+`). The package ships no decoder, no lifecycle scripts, and no network I/O — importing it does not decrypt, evaluate, or transmit the blob. The stated Next.js-docs purpose is inconsistent with shipping an opaque encrypted payload as the package's sole public API, a pattern consistent with staging a payload for a separate decoder component. Standalone, this package performs no exfiltration, code execution, or credential access against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
